messages.author: Dhananjay
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am using the RAMD module of AMBER to generate trajectories of ligand
dissociation. In this regard, if I wish to cite the RAMD methods, I found
the paper on random expulsion molecular dynamics (*J. Mol. Biol.* *303*,
797–811 (2000)). However, I could not find reference for RAMD
implementation in AMBER.
How to cite RAMD of AMMER in poster or publication?
Any suggestions or help will be highly appreciated.
Dhananjay
--------------------------------------------------------------
Dhananjay Joshi
Postdoc Research Fellow
Research Center for Applied Science
Academia Sinica, Taipei-115, Taiwan
--------------------------------------------------------------
